text:
alex (People Ops): Quick mid-cycle check-in and a couple of clarifications before manager calibrations next week. Self-assessments close Fri Jul 1 23:59 PT. Manager calibration week is Jul 4-8; final manager submissions due Mon Jul 11.

tanvi (Eng Manager): Thanks Alex. Two quick asks: 1) Is there a single upload for the scoring sheet or do we paste into the form? 2) Can we reserve a timezone-friendly slot for Eng?

alex (People Ops): 1) Download the scoring sheet, fill it, then upload the CSV in the manager submission form (link in the guide). 2) Srini is blocking a late-afternoon PT slot Thu Jul 7 16:00-17:30 PT for Eng+Product; if you need alternate times add availability to the shared doodle.

matt (IC): Clarifying: hires who started Jun 10 (3 weeks before) — do they get a rating?

alex (People Ops): Policy update for this cycle: hires <30 days = no formal rating. Please add a concise "Onboarding & Ramp" entry in the manager form with 2 bullets: current focus and recommended checkpoints. Hiring ops will ingest that.

hannah (Recruiter): Can we make that Onboarding & Ramp field required for hires <90 days? Hiring wants visibility.

alex (People Ops): Done. For anyone <90 days, the field is now required. Keep it short.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Self-assessments due in 5 days" to post in #people-ops and department channels.

tanvi (Eng Manager): Extension policy question: last cycle we had a long medical leave. What's allowed now?

alex (People Ops): Standard extension is up to 3 business days for short absences. For longer accommodations (medical, parental leave >3 days) submit an exception ticket and HR will review; exceptions up to 15 business days can be approved on a case-by-case basis. Use the exceptions form in the guide.

srini (Director): Heads-up for managers: keep calibration notes factual and evidence-linked. If a case escalates, we'll ask for the scoring sheet + 2 supporting data points (PRs, metrics, dashboards).

tanvi (Eng Manager): How will outcomes be delivered to ICs? Some missed emails last time.

alex (People Ops): After you submit, peopleops-bot will send an autogenerated summary email (rating + manager comment). Expect delivery within 72 hours of your submitted slot. Managers: double-check comment copy before hitting submit.

matt (IC): Is peer feedback mandatory? I collaborate with several teams and would like to include it.

alex (People Ops): Peer feedback is optional but encouraged for cross-team contributors. There's a 2-question peer form in the guide; it should take <5 minutes to complete.

tanvi (Eng Manager): One operational ask: can we get a paste-ready invite body for calibration meetings?

alex (People Ops): Yep, copy/paste below for invites:

```
Subject: Calibration — Team {NAME}
Agenda: 1) Context & scope (5m)
2) Borderline cases + discussion (50m)
3) Finalize ratings & capture notes (15m)
Prep: scoring sheet CSV, 2 example datapoints (PRs/metrics), list of hires <90d
```

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager calibration week starts in 2 days" to post to team channels.

hannah (Recruiter): One last note from hiring ops: please add short "Promotion signals" bullet where relevant; we flagged a few borderline promotable folks last cycle without clear notes.

alex (People Ops): Added an optional Promotion Signals field to the manager form. Keep it evidence-based (1-2 bullets).

tanvi (Eng Manager): Filed one extension for an engineer recovering from surgery. Thanks for the exception guidance.

alex (People Ops): Got it, Tanvi. I'll fast-track and confirm by EOD tomorrow. DM me for edge cases. :wave:
